quarterly_data.signal: FormFactor opened its Farmers Branch (Texas) manufacturing facility, expanding production capacity for advanced probe card technologies; the company says the adoption of advanced packaging for GPUs, custom ASICs and HBM is driving extraordinary demand for advanced semiconductor test solutions. CEO Mike Slessor: the opening 'reflects our commitment to investing in the capabilities and technology leadership needed to support our customers'.
